2607.01940.title: Conditional Co-Ablation: Recovering Self-Repair Backups in Transformer Circuits
2607.01940.paper_summary: Mechanistic interpretability often relies on component-level interventions to discover how a model produces a behavior. This guides attribution, capability knockout, and model pruning downstream to operate by scoring each unit by the effect of ablation in isolation. Such first-order scoring is natural when component importance is additive, but becomes misleading when a transformer self-repairs: after a primary component is removed, a dormant backup can take over, muting the primary's measured effect while the backup itself appears irrelevant on the intact model. We recast this failure as a recovery task, conditional circuit completion, and introduce Conditional Co-Ablation (CoAx), a label-free, output-grounded score that asks how much each remaining unit's ablation effect grows once a primary set has been removed. This conditional growth exposes the second-order interaction that single-unit scores discard. On the GPT-2-small IOI circuit, CoAx raises backup-head recovery from 0.33 to 0.91 ROC-AUC, outperforming all baselines, including self-repair-aware gradient scores (best 0.82); counterfactual patching verifies that the recovered heads causally carry the repair. The same label-free procedure transfers to induction across eight models. Beyond discovery, the recovered backups correct self-repair-masked attribution, identify the components required for capability knockout, and yield repair-aware structured pruning scaling from 124M to 7B. Component importance is therefore not merely an isolated-unit property: in robust circuits, the components that matter can become visible only under the interventions that make them necessary.
2607.01940.paper_summary_zh: 機械解釋性通常依賴於組件級別的干預，以發現模型如何產生某種行為。<lb/>這指導了歸因、能力剔除和模型修剪，通過對每個單元進行評分來操作，評分的依據是單獨切除的效果。<lb/>當組件的重要性是可加的時，這種一級評分是自然的，但當Transformer自我修復時，這就變得具有誤導性：在主要組件被移除後，一個休眠的備份可以接管，抑制主要組件的測量效果，而備份本身在完整模型上似乎無關緊要。<lb/>我們將這一失敗重新表述為一個恢復任務，即條件電路完成，並引入條件共同切除（CoAx），這是一種無標籤、基於輸出的評分，旨在詢問在移除一組主要單元後，每個剩餘單元的切除效果增長了多少。<lb/>這種條件增長揭示了單一單元評分所忽略的二級交互作用。在 GPT-2-small IOI 電路上，CoAx 將備份頭的恢復率從 0.33 提高到 0.91 ROC-AUC，超越了所有基準，包括自我修復感知的梯度評分（最佳 0.82）；反事實修補驗證了恢復的頭部在因果上承擔了修復的責任。<lb/>相同的無標籤程序可以轉移到八個模型的歸納中。<lb/>除了發現，恢復的備份修正了自我修復掩蔽的歸因，識別出能力剔除所需的組件，並產生從 124M 擴展到 7B 的修復感知結構化修剪。因此，組件的重要性不僅僅是孤立單元的特性：在穩健的電路中，重要的組件只有在需要它們的干預下才能變得可見。
